expectations.buyer: DNA synthesis providers, biosecurity/compliance leaders, funders, and institutional buyers of synthetic nucleic acids
expectations.pain: Providers and customers need consistent sequence screening, customer verification, escalation, and audit evidence across changing guidance and threat databases
expectations.strongestIncumbent: Provider screening pipelines, IBBIS Common Mechanism, SecureDNA, IGSC protocols, government guidance, and customer due diligence
expectations.biggestRisk: Free/open screening mechanisms and provider-controlled sensitive systems may absorb benchmarking, while public testing could expose evasion methods
